about: Wikidata, the free knowledge graph run by the Wikimedia Foundation. This CLI searches items, properties, lexemes and EntitySchemas; fetches entity JSON and claims; exports RDF; checks constraint violations; parses and formats values; and sets statements through the MediaWiki/Wikibase API.

commands.summary: Search Wikidata entities (items, properties, lexemes or EntitySchemas) by label or alias. Returns matching IDs with label and description.

params.name: search
params.description: Text to search for in labels and aliases

params.name: type
params.description: Entity type to search

params.name: language
params.description: Language code to search labels in, e.g. en, de, fr

params.name: uselang
params.description: Language for the returned labels and descriptions

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum results per page (max 50) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: continue
params.description: Offset for the next page; use the 'search-continue' value from the previous response

commands.summary: Get the full JSON of one entity by ID: an item (Q42), property (P31), lexeme (L7) or other entity type. Includes labels, descriptions, aliases, claims, sitelinks, and lexeme forms/senses. Optionally f

params.name: id
params.description: Entity ID, e.g. Q42 (item), P31 (property), L7 (lexeme)

params.name: revision
params.description: Specific revision ID to fetch (the entity's lastrevid by default)

commands.summary: Batch-fetch one or more entities by ID through wbgetentities, limited to the chosen parts (claims, labels, descriptions, aliases, sitelinks, info) and languages.

params.name: ids
params.description: Pipe-separated entity IDs (max 50), e.g. Q42|Q513|P31

params.name: props
params.description: Pipe-separated parts to return: info, sitelinks, sitelinks/urls, aliases, labels, descriptions, claims, datatype

params.name: languages
params.description: Pipe-separated language codes to filter labels and descriptions, e.g. en|de

commands.summary: Export one entity as RDF, in Turtle (ttl) or N-Triples (nt).

params.name: id
params.description: Entity ID, e.g. Q42

params.name: format
params.description: RDF serialization

commands.summary: Run Wikidata property constraint checks on an entity. Returns violations, warnings and suggestions per statement.

params.name: id
params.description: Pipe-separated entity IDs to check, e.g. Q42 or P31

params.name: status
params.description: Pipe-separated result statuses to include: violation, warning, suggestion, bad-parameters, compliance, exception, todo, not-in-scope, deprecated

params.name: uselang
params.description: Language for constraint messages

commands.summary: Parse user-typed text (a date, quantity, coordinate, etc.) into a Wikibase datavalue JSON for a given datatype, the same way the statement editor does.

params.name: datatype
params.description: Property datatype, e.g. time, quantity, string, globe-coordinate, wikibase-item, url, external-id, monolingualtext

params.name: values
params.description: Pipe-separated raw input strings to parse, e.g. '1952' or '11 March 1952'

params.name: validate
params.description: Also validate the parsed values against the datatype

params.name: uselang
params.description: Language the input is written in

commands.summary: Render a Wikibase datavalue JSON as human-readable text or HTML, e.g. resolve an item ID to its label.

params.name: datavalue
params.description: Datavalue JSON, e.g. {"type":"wikibase-entityid","value":{"id":"Q42"}}

params.name: datatype
params.description: Property datatype of the value, e.g. wikibase-item, time, string

params.name: generate
params.description: Output format

params.name: uselang
params.description: Language for labels in the output
